problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $M,$ given by

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & -2 & 1 & 4 \\ 1 & -1 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation ${R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{1}$ on $M?$

feedback.problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $V,$ given by

$$
V=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 9 & -2 & 6 \\ 4 & 4 & 6 & 7 \\ 9 & 0 & 5 & 7\end{aligned}].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the following row operations on $V?$

$$
\begin{aligned}{R}_{1} & ↔{R}_{3} \\ {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{3}\end{aligned}
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Let's list the required operations:

- The operation ${R}_{1}↔{R}_{3}$ means that we need to swap the first and third rows.

- The operation ${R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{3}$ means that we need to add $-1$ times the third row to the second row.

Applying the operations, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}V & =[\begin{aligned}-1 & 9 & -2 & 6 \\ 4 & 4 & 6 & 7 \\ 9 & 0 & 5 & 7\end{aligned}]\,{R}_{1}↔{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}9 & 0 & 5 & 7 \\ 4 & 4 & 6 & 7 \\ -1 & 9 & -2 & 6\end{aligned}]\,{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}9 & 0 & 5 & 7 \\ 4+(-1)(-1) & 4+(-1)(9) & 6+(-1)(-2) & 7+(-1)(6) \\ -1 & 9 & -2 & 6\end{aligned}] \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}9 & 0 & 5 & 7 \\ 5 & -5 & 8 & 1 \\ -1 & 9 & -2 & 6\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
